claim_text: A USDA official says it was a cyberthreat, not a software update
summary: USDA's under secretary for farm production and conservation told reporters the week-long disruption was a 'cyberthreat' and not a 'software update'.
detail: DTN and AgWeb each report his remarks from press events. We found no written USDA statement, and DTN says USDA's press office had not responded.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Two outlets that were not copying each other report the official's on-the-record remarks.

claim_text: An outside actor got into the farmer-payment system
summary: NBC News, citing sources, says hackers accessed the system that pays farmers. ABC News says one source named the farmer-payment tool as one system affected.
detail: The sources are anonymous. USDA's under secretary says protective systems worked and 'people that were trying to do harm weren't able to do it', which does not fit a successful break-in. Reuters, relaying NBC, says its sources are two former USDA officials and that the payments database is the known extent of the intrusion so far.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Two outlets cite anonymous sources; Reuters only relays NBC and does not count as a separate source. The official account points the other way.

summary: Nobody has been named. Nextgov says it is not clear who carried out the intrusion, and Reuters says it is not known who was responsible. We found no claim of responsibility.
label: Not established

summary: Nextgov says it is not clear whether any data was copied out. USDA's under secretary says no data was lost.
detail: The official statement has not been checked by anyone outside USDA.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The reporting and the official statement do not settle the question.

claim_text: USDA found a security incident and reset all database passwords
summary: Nextgov says an internal email sent Monday said USDA's cyber operations center 'uncovered a security incident' and that all database passwords in all environments had to be reset, which forced application restarts and caused outages.
detail: Nextgov viewed the email. DTN repeats the report from Nextgov, so it counts as one source.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: One outlet saw the email and quotes it.

claim_text: Some outages may have another cause
summary: The under secretary also said some Farm Service Agency systems could have been down because of maintenance, and that 'there could be multiple reasons'.
label: Reported

claim_text: Farm loan, payment and mapping tools went down
summary: DTN reports outages since Monday in FSA's loan software, NRCS's ProTracts program, which releases farmer payments, and a service desk tool used to map projects. The under secretary acknowledged delays to farmer loans and payments.
detail: Nextgov reports that many financial tools for payments between the agency and farmers were affected.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The official acknowledges the delays and three outlets describe the affected tools.

claim_text: The disruption began around Monday, Nov 16
summary: The internal email Nextgov saw is dated Monday, Nov 16, ABC says a notice went out Monday, and DTN says employees reported outages from Monday. The under secretary called it a week-long event on Friday.
detail: NBC says the agency told employees on Thursday, which may be a later notice. The sources disagree on who was told what, and when.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Three outlets point to Monday for the start of the outages.

claim_text: The under secretary says no personal information was involved
summary: He said there was no personally identifiable information involved and no data was lost, because protective systems worked.
detail: This is his statement to reporters. It has not been checked by anyone outside USDA.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: DTN and AgWeb both report the statement.

claim_text: Most systems expected back by Friday night or over the weekend
summary: The under secretary said most systems should be back online by close of business on Friday, Nov 20, and if not, work would continue over the weekend.
detail: We have not seen a report that they are back.
label: Confirmed

summary: As of Sunday morning, Nov 22, we found no report that the affected systems are fully restored. On Saturday, Nov 21, the FSA administrator said technicians were still working to restore service.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Friday's reports gave expectations, not confirmation, and Saturday's report says the work is still going on.

claim_text: A link to the week's other outages
summary: DTN reports intelligence officials told Congress on Wednesday that recent outages were separate and tied to maintenance or technical changes. No source ties USDA to the others.
detail: The FAA, NSA, Microsoft 365 and other incidents have their own pages on this site.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: No source links the USDA incident to the others.

claim_text: CISA has not commented and referred questions to USDA
summary: Reuters says the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency referred its questions to USDA, which did not immediately respond.
detail: We found no written statement from USDA, CISA or the FBI.
label: Reported

claim_text: The Dec 11 ARC/PLC sign-up deadline is not being extended
summary: The FSA administrator and the under secretary told AgWeb the Dec 11 deadline for 2026 ARC/PLC sign-up will not move. Farmers who contact their county office before then can go on a register that counts as on time.
detail: Both officials spoke on the record to one outlet.
label: Reported

claim_text: A federal watchdog found gaps in USDA's food-sector cyber work the same week
summary: A GAO report released Thursday, Nov 19, says USDA and FDA have not fully met five of 16 legal requirements for food-sector cybersecurity, citing a lack of staff. USDA disagreed with GAO's recommendations.
detail: The report is about USDA's role supporting the wider food and farm sector, not about its own computer systems, and it does not mention this incident. ABC News and AgWeb both noted it alongside the outage.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: GAO's own report page states the findings, the recommendations and USDA's disagreement.

claim_text: Staff were warned on Tuesday that systems coming back were not yet safe to use
summary: DTN says a Tuesday email to agency employees said some applications 'may appear to be coming back online' but 'have not yet been fully restored or verified for production use. Proceed at your own risk.'
detail: DTN obtained the email; no other outlet has reported it. It fits the Monday email Nextgov describes, in which restarts were causing outages.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: One outlet quotes the email it obtained.

claim_text: The Dec 18 dairy coverage sign-up deadline is also coming up
summary: DTN notes dairy producers have until Dec 18 to enroll in the 2027 Dairy Margin Coverage program, in addition to the Dec 11 ARC/PLC deadline.
detail: We found no report that either deadline will move.
label: Reported

claim_text: On Nov 21 the FSA administrator said technicians were still working to restore service
summary: Red River Farm Network reports that FSA Administrator Bill Beam says technicians are working to restore service. Farmers with problems are told to contact their county office, record enrollment attempts and ask about paper contracts.
detail: One outlet reports this, and it paraphrases him rather than quoting him. It does not say whether the outage was a hack.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The outlet reports what the administrator said.
